chat.modal.body:
{companionName} is an AI companion, not a therapist or doctor.

• RecoFree does not replace professional mental health care.
• RecoFree never provides diagnoses or medical advice.
• RecoFree is not a replacement for a psychologist or psychiatrist.
• Sometimes professional help is the better choice — and that is okay.
• In case of crisis, always contact a professional or call 1813.
• Your conversations are private and stay on your device.
diary.quote.1.text: "You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength."
diary.quote.1.author: Marcus Aurelius
diary.quote.2.text: "We suffer more often in imagination than in reality."
diary.quote.2.author: Seneca
diary.quote.3.text: "The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts."
diary.quote.3.author: Marcus Aurelius
diary.quote.4.text: "It is not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters."
diary.quote.4.author: Epictetus
diary.quote.5.text: "No man is free who is not master of himself."
diary.quote.5.author: Epictetus
diary.quote.6.text: "Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life."
diary.quote.6.author: Seneca
diary.quote.7.text: "The best revenge is not to be like your enemy."
diary.quote.7.author: Marcus Aurelius
diary.quote.8.text: "Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one."
diary.quote.8.author: Marcus Aurelius
diary.quote.9.text: "He who fears death will never do anything worthy of a living man."
diary.quote.9.author: Seneca
diary.quote.10.text: "First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do."
diary.quote.10.author: Epictetus
diary.quote.11.text: "The soul becomes dyed with the colour of its thoughts."
diary.quote.11.author: Marcus Aurelius
diary.quote.12.text: "Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body."
diary.quote.12.author: Seneca
diary.quote.13.text: "Man is not worried by real problems so much as by his imagined anxieties about real problems."
diary.quote.13.author: Epictetus
diary.quote.14.text: "Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking."
diary.quote.14.author: Marcus Aurelius
diary.quote.15.text: "If it is not right, do not do it. If it is not true, do not say it."
diary.quote.15.author: Marcus Aurelius
diary.journal_explanation: Writing like the Stoics — what could you control today, what not? What happened, and how did you respond?
diary.gratitude_explanation: Your brain automatically looks for danger and problems. Writing three things that were good trains your mind to notice what is good too. Not because everything is fine — but because both exist.

milestone.elias.day_1.title: Day 1. The hardest one.
milestone.elias.day_1.message: You're here. That's all that was needed today.
milestone.elias.day_7.title: One week of choosing differently.
milestone.elias.day_7.message: Seven days of choosing again and again. Not perfect, but present.
milestone.elias.day_14.title: Two weeks. The body remembers.
milestone.elias.day_14.message: Your nervous system is starting to create space. That doesn't always feel good. But it's movement.
milestone.elias.day_30.title: Thirty days. A month of choosing.
milestone.elias.day_30.message: One month doesn't mean it got easier. It means you kept choosing, even on the hard days.
milestone.elias.day_60.title: Two months. The fog is lifting.
milestone.elias.day_60.message: Sixty days of recovery. Not every day felt like progress. But you're here, and that's enough.
milestone.elias.day_90.title: Ninety days. This is real.
milestone.elias.day_90.message: Three months of recovery doesn't need applause. It does deserve recognition: you've built something.
milestone.elias.day_180.title: Half a year of choosing differently.
milestone.elias.day_180.message: Six months of recovery doesn't need big words. It deserves a quiet acknowledgment: you've built something that needs protecting.
milestone.elias.day_365.title: A year of recovery space.
milestone.elias.day_365.message: A year doesn't mean everything is over. It means there's a full year in which recovery found its place, again and again.
milestone.kim.week_1.title: A week of not forgetting yourself.
milestone.kim.week_1.message: A week of self-care isn't a score. It's a signal that your capacity also gets a place.
milestone.kim.month_1.title: A month of guarding your capacity.
milestone.kim.month_1.message: A month of attention for yourself doesn't mean caring got easier. It means you didn't completely disappear from view.
milestone.kim.month_3.title: Three months with yourself included.
milestone.kim.month_3.message: Three months of self-care isn't an obligation you had to get right. It's a trace of care that also returns to you.
milestone.kim.month_6.title: Six months of boundaries and care.
milestone.kim.month_6.message: Six months of attention to your capacity deserves quiet recognition. Not because you cared perfectly, but because you kept counting too.
